---
name: bmad-product-brief
description: Create a concise product brief for a proposed feature or direction in the RAG MVP. Use when asked for a product concept or brief.
---

# Product brief

Capture problem, users, value, proposed capability, scope, non-goals, success
measures, constraints, and open questions. Ground it in the current product and
deployment. Keep it shorter than a PRD; use `bmad-prd` for detailed requirements.
Write a file only when requested.
